alternatives.argument: The algorithm item directly defines the perturbation conditions, two oracle calls, shared numerator, coordinate division and failure status. It does not rely on the unavailable 1992 article for a theorem; the retrieved Spall overview and Fu chapter support the method context.

The complete proof reduces the objective along each perturbation ray to the scalar central difference, applies the batch-12 C^3 remainder bound, and cancels off-diagonal terms by independent symmetric perturbations with finite reciprocal moments.

The complete conditional proof sums the coordinate inequalities (Y+−Y−)^2≤2|Y+|^2+2|Y−|^2, applies the stated weighted conditional second moment, then bounds vector conditional variance by the second moment.

The complete local proof derives conditional descent with bias error B G alpha_k c_k^2 and variance error proportional to alpha_k^2/c_k^2, checks integrability and adaptedness, invokes the exact Robbins–Siegmund interface and proves the liminf stationarity conclusion from sum alpha_k=∞.
